subject: Consolidated invoicing request for capacity expansion & billing recipient change
messages:
From: Laura Chen <finance@clearpath.ai>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: accounts-payable@clearpath.ai
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidated invoicing & PO for upcoming capacity expansion

Hi Priya,

We're ramping the ClearPath AI commitment to add 4 additional Dedicated units starting April 1, 2027. Finance is requesting a couple of billing updates to streamline ops:

- Can Redwood consolidate all capacity invoices for our account onto a single monthly invoice (one invoice for all Dedicated units + any overage) instead of per-cluster billing?
- New bill-to recipient: billing@clearpath.ai (please route going forward).
- Our procurement team will issue PO #67890 for the expanded capacity — attaching the PO here.
- We'll need Redwood's vendor W9 to add you to our system; we can send ours after you confirm billing recipient.

Also: we prefer Net45 terms for renewals/expansions if possible. Please confirm whether Net45 is acceptable for the PO above or if finance needs a formal amendment.

Thanks — I can hop on a quick call if helpful.

Laura Chen
Director, Finance
ClearPath AI
attachments: PO_67890.pdf
From: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
To: Laura Chen <finance@clearpath.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consolidated invoicing & PO for upcoming capacity expansion

Hi Laura — thanks for the note and the PO. Congrats on the expansion!

Quick answers and next steps:

- Consolidated invoicing: we can do a single monthly invoice that aggregates Dedicated capacity and overages. We'll need to map the existing active clusters to the new bill-to so amounts roll up correctly.
- Bill-to change: we can route to billing@clearpath.ai effective for invoices with start-of-service on or after 2027-04-01. Confirm that date works for you.
- Net45: finance team flagged that Net45 is possible for the new PO but requires a signed amendment to the MSA to record the term change.
- W9 / EIN: please attach your W9 (or W-8 if foreign). Once we receive it we will provide Redwood's W9 back to you and update our billing system.

I've looped in Marissa from Billing Ops and Connor (your AE) to draft the amendment and schedule any required signatures. Marissa — can you prepare a short billing amendment that:
  * records consolidated monthly invoicing to billing@clearpath.ai,
  * records PO #67890 as the purchase instrument for the April expansion, and
  * updates payment terms to Net45 for this PO only (we can track longer-term term changes separately)?

Connor — please confirm the service activation date (operational) so Marissa can set invoice cutoff and effective billing month.

If it helps, Laura, we can do a 20-min call today to align.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Laura Chen <finance@clearpath.ai>, priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Consolidated invoicing & PO for upcoming capacity expansion

Hi Laura / Priya,

Thanks — attaching a draft billing amendment for review (redwood-billing-amendment-draft.pdf). Key notes:

- Draft covers consolidated monthly invoicing to billing@clearpath.ai starting 2027-04-01.
- Amendment references PO #67890 and sets Net45 for sums invoiced under that PO.
- We will issue a single invoice per month listing each Dedicated cluster as line items so your AP can reconcile usage.

Action items for ClearPath:
  1) Please confirm billing@clearpath.ai is the correct billing recipient and whether AP will accept a consolidated invoice PDF plus CSV lineitem export (we can include both).
  2) Attach your W9 so we can provision your vendor record.
  3) If you want the Net45 to apply company-wide (not just PO #67890), say so and we'll route to legal for a broader amendment.

Priya / Connor: once Laura confirms, I'll convert the draft into a DocuSign for signature.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-billing-amendment-draft.pdf
From: Laura Chen <finance@clearpath.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: accounts-payable@clearpath.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consolidated invoicing & PO for upcoming capacity expansion

Marissa — that draft looks good at a glance. Quick confirmations:

- billing@clearpath.ai is the correct recipient and AP accepts a single PDF invoice + CSV for line items.
- Attached is our W9 (W9_ClearPathAI.pdf) and the signed PO (PO_67890.pdf).
- We would like the Net45 to apply to this PO only for now; we may request a company-wide change during the annual review.

Can you let us know when to expect the DocuSign? Also: will consolidated invoices include a short usage summary (total token usage / compute hours) for each cluster? Our AP wants a quick reconciliation line.

Thanks — happy to join a call if you want to lock the details.

Laura Chen
Director, Finance, ClearPath AI
attachments: W9_ClearPathAI.pdf, PO_67890.pdf
